Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Andrew Wiggins?

Andrew Wiggins is 31 years old.

Where was Andrew Wiggins born?

Andrew Wiggins was born in Toronto, Ontario.

When was Andrew Wiggins born?

Andrew Wiggins was born on February 23, 1995.

How tall is Andrew Wiggins?

Andrew Wiggins is 6-6 (198 cm) tall.

How much does Andrew Wiggins weigh?

Andrew Wiggins weighs 197 lbs (89 kg).

Is Andrew Wiggins in the Hall of Fame?

Andrew Wiggins is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Andrew Wiggins drafted?

Andrew Wiggins was drafted by Cleveland Cavaliers, 1st round (1st pick, 1st overall), 2014 NBA Draft.

What position does Andrew Wiggins play?

Small Forward and Power Forward.

What is Andrew Wiggins' net worth?

Andrew Wiggins has made at least $251,390,650 playing professional basketball.

How much does Andrew Wiggins make?

Andrew Wiggins made $33,616,770 in 2023.

How many rings does Andrew Wiggins have?

Andrew Wiggins has won one championship.

What is Andrew Wiggins' Instagram account?

Andrew Wiggins is on Instagram at 22wiggins.

What schools did Andrew Wiggins attend?

Andrew Wiggins attended Huntington Prep in Huntington, West Virginia and Kansas.

What are Andrew Wiggins' nicknames?

Maple Jordan, Junior Jordan, The Prospect, Mr. Fantastic, Wiggs, Two-Way Wiggs, Air Canada are nicknames for Andrew Wiggins.
